mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'RUNNING'), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'STOPPED'), 0) AS stopped, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'FAULT'), 0) AS fault, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'REPAIR'), 0) AS repair, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'MAINTENANCE'), 0) AS maintenance, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'OFFLINE'), 0) AS offline, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'INSPECTION'), 0) AS inspection, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code IS NULL OR cs.status_code NOT IN ( 'RUNNING', 'STOPPED', 'FAULT', 'REPAIR', 'MAINTENANCE', 'OFFLINE', 'INSPECTION' )), 0) AS other FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND cs.equipment_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 AND

SELECT palette.status_code, palette.status_name, palette.display_color, COUNT(e.id) AS equipment_count, ROUND( COUNT(e.id) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(e.id)) OVER (), 0), 6 ) AS proportion FROM visualization_status_color palette LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = palette.tenant_id AND cs.status_code = palette.status_code LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = cs.tenant_id AND e.id = cs.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 AND
AND e.organization_id IN
#{organizationId}
WHERE palette.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND palette.status = 1 AND palette.deleted = 0 GROUP BY palette.id, palette.status_code, palette.status_name, palette.display_color, palette.sort_order ORDER BY palette.sort_order, palette.id

SELECT organization.id AS organization_id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, organization.organization_type, COUNT(e.id) AS equipment_count, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'RUNNING'), 0) AS running_count, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'FAULT'), 0) AS fault_count, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code IN ('STOPPED', 'IDLE')), 0) AS stopped_count, COALESCE(SUM(cs.status_code = 'OFFLINE'), 0) AS offline_count FROM equipment e JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND cs.equipment_id = e.id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 AND
GROUP BY organization.id, organization.organization_code, organization.organization_name, organization.organization_type, organization.sort_order ORDER BY organization.sort_order, organization.id

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, e.organization_id, organization.organization_name, COALESCE(cs.status_code, 'OFFLINE') AS status_code, COALESCE(palette.status_name, '离线') AS status_name, COALESCE(palette.display_color, '#475569') AS display_color, cs.status_since, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cs.status_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS duration_seconds, ROUND(AVG(oee.oee_rate), 6) AS today_oee, CASE WHEN cs.status_code IN ('STOPPED', 'FAULT', 'REPAIR') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, cs.status_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= #{longStopMinutes} THEN TRUE WHEN cs.status_code = 'OFFLINE' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, cs.status_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= #{longOfflineMinutes} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS long_duration FROM equipment e JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND cs.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN visualization_status_color palette ON palette.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND palette.status_code = cs.status_code AND palette.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_oee_record oee ON oee.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND oee.equipment_id = e.id AND oee.production_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND oee.deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 1 AND
GROUP BY e.id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, e.organization_id, organization.organization_name, cs.status_code, cs.status_since, palette.status_name, palette.display_color ORDER BY long_duration DESC, FIELD(cs.status_code, 'FAULT', 'REPAIR', 'OFFLINE', 'STOPPED', 'MAINTENANCE', 'INSPECTION', 'IDLE', 'RUNNING'), cs.status_since, e.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT #{workflowType} AS workflow_type, COUNT(*) AS due, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED')), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR (t.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND t.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal_count > 0), 0) AS abnormal, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 6 ) AS completion_rate, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.completed_time <= t.due_time), 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0), 0), 6 ) AS on_time_rate FROM
inspection_task maintenance_task
t JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND e.id = t.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count FROM
inspection_abnormal maintenance_abnormal
WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY task_id ) abnormalities ON abnormalities.task_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.planned_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND

SELECT t.planned_date AS statistic_date, #{workflowType} AS workflow_type, COUNT(*) AS due, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(t.task_status = 'OVERDUE' OR (t.task_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'VOIDED') AND t.due_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(abnormal_count > 0), 0) AS abnormal FROM
inspection_task maintenance_task
t JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND e.id = t.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count FROM
inspection_abnormal maintenance_abnormal
WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY task_id ) abnormalities ON abnormalities.task_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.planned_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND
GROUP BY t.planned_date ORDER BY t.planned_date
SELECT CAST(parameter_value AS SIGNED) FROM system_parameter WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parameter_key = #{parameterKey} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE organization_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM organization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{organizationId} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM organization child JOIN organization_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.status = 1 AND child.deleted = 0 ) SELECT id FROM organization_tree

SELECT scene.id, scene.parent_scene_id, scene.scene_code, scene.scene_name, scene.scene_level, scene.organization_id, organization.organization_name, scene.model_resource_id, scene.background_color, scene.grid_color, scene.camera_x, scene.camera_y, scene.camera_z, scene.target_x, scene.target_y, scene.target_z, scene.auto_rotate_flag, scene.sort_order, scene.status, scene.description, scene.version FROM visualization_scene scene JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = scene.tenant_id AND organization.id = scene.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 WHERE scene.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene.id = #{sceneId} AND scene.deleted = 0 AND LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE scene_path AS ( SELECT id, parent_scene_id, 0 AS depth FROM visualization_scene WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{sceneId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_scene_id, child.depth + 1 FROM visualization_scene parent JOIN scene_path child ON child.parent_scene_id = parent.id WHERE parent.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent.deleted = 0 ) SELECT FROM scene_path path JOIN visualization_scene scene ON scene.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene.id = path.id JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = scene.tenant_id AND organization.id = scene.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 ORDER BY path.depth DESC

SELECT node.id, node.scene_id, node.node_code, node.display_name, node.node_type, node.organization_id, node.equipment_id, node.target_scene_id, node.model_resource_id, model.model_format, model.primitive_type, model.attachment_id, model.fallback_color, node.position_x, node.position_y, node.position_z, node.rotation_x, node.rotation_y, node.rotation_z, node.scale_x, node.scale_y, node.scale_z, node.label_visible_flag, node.visible_flag, node.sort_order, COALESCE(cs.status_code, 'OFFLINE') AS status_code, COALESCE(palette.status_name, '离线') AS status_name, COALESCE(palette.display_color, model.fallback_color) AS display_color, COALESCE(palette.pulse_flag, 0) AS pulse_flag, node.version FROM visualization_scene_node node JOIN visualization_scene scene ON scene.tenant_id = node.tenant_id AND scene.id = node.scene_id AND scene.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN visualization_model_resource model ON model.tenant_id = node.tenant_id AND model.id = node.model_resource_id AND model.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = node.tenant_id AND e.id = node.equipment_id AND e.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND cs.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN visualization_status_color palette ON palette.tenant_id = node.tenant_id AND palette.status_code = cs.status_code AND palette.deleted = 0 WHERE node.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND node.scene_id = #{sceneId} AND node.deleted = 0 AND ( node.node_type != 'EQUIPMENT' OR (e.id IS NOT NULL AND ) ) ORDER BY node.sort_order, node.id

SELECT id, resource_code, resource_name, resource_level, attachment_id, model_format, primitive_type, fallback_color, thumbnail_attachment_id, description, status, version FROM visualization_model_resource WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, status_code, status_name, display_color, emissive_color, pulse_flag, sort_order, status, description, version FROM visualization_status_color WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.equipment_code, e.equipment_name, category.category_name, organization.organization_name, location.location_name, COALESCE(cs.status_code, 'OFFLINE') AS status_code, COALESCE(palette.status_name, '离线') AS status_name, COALESCE(palette.display_color, '#475569') AS status_color, cs.status_since, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cs.status_since, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS status_duration_seconds, responsible.real_name AS responsible_name, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(history.started_time, CURRENT_DATE()), LEAST(COALESCE(history.ended_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )) / 60 FROM equipment_status_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND history.equipment_id = e.id AND history.to_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND COALESCE(history.ended_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= CURRENT_DATE() ), 0) AS today_run_minutes, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, GREATEST(history.started_time, CURRENT_DATE()), LEAST(COALESCE(history.ended_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) )) / 60 FROM equipment_status_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND history.equipment_id = e.id AND history.to_status_code IN ('STOPPED', 'FAULT', 'REPAIR', 'OFFLINE') AND COALESCE(history.ended_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) >= CURRENT_DATE() ), 0) AS today_stop_minutes, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(oee.oee_rate), 6) FROM equipment_oee_record oee WHERE oee.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND oee.equipment_id = e.id AND oee.production_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND oee.deleted = 0) AS today_oee, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND task.equipment_id = e.id AND task.planned_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND task.deleted = 0) AS today_inspection_due, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND task.equipment_id = e.id AND task.planned_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND task.task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND task.deleted = 0) AS today_inspection_completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND task.equipment_id = e.id AND task.planned_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND task.deleted = 0) AS today_maintenance_due, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND task.equipment_id = e.id AND task.planned_date = CURRENT_DATE() AND task.task_status = 'COMPLETED' AND task.deleted = 0) AS today_maintenance_completed, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspection_abnormal abnormal WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND abnormal.equipment_id = e.id AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_abnormal abnormal WHERE abnormal.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND abnormal.equipment_id = e.id AND abnormal.abnormal_status != 'CLOSED' AND abnormal.deleted = 0) ) AS open_abnormal_count FROM equipment e JOIN equipment_category category ON category.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND category.id = e.category_id AND category.deleted = 0 JOIN organization ON organization.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND organization.id = e.organization_id AND organization.deleted = 0 JOIN location ON location.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND location.id = e.location_id AND location.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_user responsible ON responsible.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND responsible.id = e.primary_responsible_user_id AND responsible.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN equipment_current_status cs ON cs.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND cs.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN visualization_status_color palette ON palette.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND palette.status_code = cs.status_code AND palette.deleted = 0 WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{equipmentId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND LIMIT 1

SELECT event_type, event_code, event_status, description, event_time FROM ( SELECT 'STATUS' AS event_type, CONCAT(COALESCE(history.from_status_code, '-'), '→', history.to_status_code) AS event_code, history.to_status_code AS event_status, history.reason AS description, history.started_time AS event_time FROM equipment_status_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND history.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} UNION ALL SELECT 'INSPECTION', task.task_code, task.task_status, task.scheme_name_snapshot, task.updated_time FROM inspection_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'MAINTENANCE', task.task_code, task.task_status, task.scheme_name_snapshot, task.updated_time FROM maintenance_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND task.deleted = 0 ) events ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
